description: This Java class manages database connections and schema initialization for a Liberty DataSource, including fallback mechanisms and schema creation for specific tables.

classes.name: LibertyConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages database connections via JNDI lookup, with schema initialization and fallback to embedded connection management.

methods.name: initializeDataSource
methods.description: Initializes the DataSource by looking up the JNDI name.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Provides a database connection, either from the DataSource or fallback.

methods.name: isLibertyDataSourceAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the DataSource is available.

methods.name: initializeDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Creates database tables if using Liberty DataSource.

methods.name: createTableIfNotExists
methods.description: Executes SQL to create a table if it does not already exist.
